description: This file contains helper methods for testing web pages in the eShopOnWeb project's functional tests. Specifically, it provides methods to extract request verification tokens and item IDs from HTML input strings using regex patterns.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to parse HTML content in functional web tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token value from an HTML string.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts the item ID from an HTML string.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs regex matching to extract a value from input based on the provided regex pattern.
